description: Réseau cyclable is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Réseau cyclable sur le territoire de l'agglomération de Montréal incluant les types d'infrastructures cyclables et les informations liées à l'accessibilité 4 saisons. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Bande cyclable, Cyclable, Mobilité, Mobilité active, Piste. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, PDF, SHP, WEB. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
